issues.description: The newly verified executable heap APIs keep legacy Verus signature/body syntax inside `verus!` instead of attaching contracts with `#[verus_spec]` attribute-mode macros.
issues.rationale: The maintainer explicitly requested #[verus_spec] macros in historical comment 6863347639. The immediate successor 38f3177997b09129271cbdebbce9c6243c551542 converts these executable heap APIs to ordinary Rust signatures with attribute contracts and proof-mode wrappers. This supports the specific migration convention requested for this PR. The same-head separate-verus-modes guideline only requires visually distinct groups and permits adjacent verified items in one verus! block; it does not by itself mandate attribute syntax or prohibit verus! for proof/spec code.
issues.source_evidence:
after/ostd/src/mm/heap/slot.rs
64-72: `SlotInfo::size` uses a Verus `returns` clause directly in its executable signature.
99-105: `into_memory` mixes an executable return with tracked destructuring in the same body.
117-139: `HeapSlot::new` embeds requires/ensures and tracked binding in the executable declaration.
197-233: the public getters likewise use legacy inline contracts.

after/ostd/src/mm/heap/slot_list.rs
55-63: `Default::default` embeds its ensures clause.
110-177: `new` and `push` mix contracts and proof declarations with executable code.
252-323: `pop` does the same.

after/AGENTS.md
30-33: Follow the VOSTD Verus Coding Guidelines for coding, specification, proof, naming, and review conventions.

Fixed rule at the same commit, docs/coding-guidelines/maintainability.md:3-9: keep executable code, specifications, and proofs in visually distinct groups.
issues.verification: source-only; historical Verus was not executed. Independently compared the selected archived Git object with immediate remote successor 38f3177997b09129271cbdebbce9c6243c551542, confirmed the systematic `#[verus_spec]` conversion, and checked the same-head separate-modes rule.

applicability.scope: Executable heap APIs migrated by this PR
applicability.rule_mapping: No universal attribute-only rule inferred from separate-verus-modes.
